# Hidden worker, fired from options (CHI) with the country var oe_y7_job: heavy work stays out of option previews.

    type = country_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {

        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 32 } oe_y7_job_c29b = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 33 } oe_y7_job_c29c = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 34 } oe_y7_job_c30a = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 35 } oe_y7_job_c30b = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 36 } oe_y7_job_d31a = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 37 } oe_y7_job_d31b = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 38 } oe_y7_job_d32 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 39 } oe_y7_job_d32b = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 40 } oe_y7_job_pr_office_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 41 } oe_y7_job_pr_office_2 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 42 } oe_y7_job_pr_office_3 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 43 } oe_y7_job_pr_recall_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 44 } oe_y7_job_pr_recall_2 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 45 } oe_y7_job_pr_recall_3 = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_y7_job
    }
}
